title: Landscape Architect - (Architecture)
description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Here is what you will do:

* Must have good experience delivering Landscape Design/ Public Realm projects in the private or public sectors.
* Must be familiar with design, tender and construction processes. International experience of the UK, Middle East or APAC regions will be considered an added advantage.
* Must be proficient in design detailing and construction techniques.
* Must be proficient in, but not limited to, AutoCAD, Revit, Adobe Creative Suite (photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator), MS Office, SketchUp, Rhino and rendering softwares like Lumion/ Enscape/ Twinmotion. Advanced experience of BIM related software in Landscape Design/ Infrastructure works will be considered an added advantage.
* Candidate should be able to assign work to junior team members and BIM technologists. Use business related software independently with ability to guide junior team members.
* Candidates should demonstrate competency in softwares, clear communications skills to gain understanding of the required tasks, quick and a methodical decision\-making approach for the design \& related tasks.

  

**Qualifications**  

Here’s what we’re looking for:

* A Masters degree in Landscape Architecture from universities of International repute will be an added advantage
* Applicants are required to have between 2\-6 years of experience in Landscape.
* Bachelor’s degree holders in Landscape Architecture or Architecture will be considered, if they can showcase relevant experience in Landscape Design project stages including design, documentation and site implementation
* Chartered candidates shall have an added advantage.

  

**Additional Information** *Our Freedom to Grow hybrid working philosophy is the cornerstone of our success as a business – supporting a culture of flexibility, trust and performance at AECOM.*


At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***


At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. title: Partner Success Manager -FED gov, Public Sector
description:
Partner Success Manager \-FED gov Location: Gurugram External job description Would you like to own building the future for a leader in the Cloud Computing business? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is building a team of business development professionals to establish relationships and manage the success of our emerging Technology and Consulting partners within the India Public Sector market for Amazon Internet Services Pvt. Ltd (AISPL), the local seller for cloud services in India. Do you have the business savvy, government business development, ecosystem experience and the technical background necessary to help further establish Amazon as a leading cloud platform provider for these partners? As a Partner Development Manager at AISPL, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mindshare and adoption of AWS cloud in the Public Sector. Your mission will be to develop AWS cloud awareness and adoption, build AWS competency, and foster the development of cloud\-based solutions with key AWS Partner Network (APN) of AISPL who deliver solutions for government, education, healthcare and non\-profits. In this role, you will manage a territory of high value APN partners while developing business and technical relationships to grow the overall business. You will have day\-to\-day interactions with these partners as they progress in their adoption of AWS cloud for their solutions, and then as they bring the solutions to market and sell jointly with AISPL. The ideal candidate will possess both a business background that enables them to drive an engagement and interact at the executive level, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact with software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about the mission, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions to all levels. Effectively developing and managing partners will require that you establish strong business and technical relationships through your knowledge of the Public Sector industry and customer requirements of AISPL. Through these relationships, you will be responsible for growing internal adoption of AWS, as well as broad organizational AWS competency in the partners in India. You will also work closely with the AWS Public Sector business development team to drive joint business engagement, as well as strategically plan for development of future opportunities and pursuits. Ideal candidates will possess both and technical business background that enables them to drive engagements and interact at multiple levels with APN partners and customers of AISPL, including the partner founders/ board. Candidates should also have strong industry experience and demonstrated the ability to think and act strategically on the government customer mission, industry directions, and partner/customer technical challenges. Roles \& Responsibilities:


* Serve as a key member of the AISPL Public Sector Team in helping to drive overall business goals.
* Manage multiple APN partners in the West states ready to develop AWS cloud competency and fulfil government transactions. Manage a set of APN partners who build vertical solutions for the Public Sector.
* Understanding of government procurement and contracting process to navigate the Public Sector contracting vehicles and RFP procedures with key strategic and advisory partners.
* Understand the legal, compliance, security, and technical considerations and certifications specific to the Public Sector that impact your APN partner ecosystem.
* Build and execute a plan to develop the competency and capabilities of the strategic and advisory APN partners in India through technical trainings/enablement, business development engagement, programs and operations that translates into a sustained and growing business portfolio for these APN partners.
* Identify specific prospects/partners/channels to approach while communicating the specific value proposition for their business and use case.
* Develop and manage the pipeline by engaging with prospects, partners, and key customers.
* Manage complex contract negotiations and liaison with the Legal group.
* Engage with APN partner teams on the new partner programs to build and scale the strategic partner engagements in the India state and local government segments.
* Develop strategic relationship with chosen public sector domain partners to ensure that they adopt AWS as their cloud platform and jointly develop GTM (Go\-To\-Market) plans with solution focused approach.

### **Basic Qualifications**


* Partner, Tech Sales

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* MBA, or Master's degree in computer science, technology, design


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Solution Architect – Python with GenAI
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're growing our team and looking to add a Solution Architect who specializes in Python and Generative AI, tasked with designing and delivering enterprise\-scale GenAI solutions suited for live production environments. Joining our Solution Architecture unit, you'll take the lead on technical investigation work, build out reusable toolkits, and help establish guidelines for LLM\-driven applications. Apply today to become part of innovative GenAI projects and help drive transformative results for our clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Construct comprehensive GenAI architectures, encompassing RAG structures, Agents, and Multi\-Agent setups, designed specifically for large enterprise clients
* Create reusable accelerator tools and reference models to standardize how solutions get delivered
* Run technical discovery workshops and provide hands\-on assistance directly to engineering teams
* Set up evaluation frameworks and establish guidelines governing the development of large language model (LLM) applications
* Partner with varied teams to ensure system architectures are built to scale properly and stay maintainable over time
* Design microservices architecture using proven patterns and up\-to\-date frameworks
* Direct the integration of cloud infrastructure components spanning platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Take charge of containerization and orchestration tasks using Docker and Kubernetes
* Weigh options and select appropriate vector database platforms, including Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma, to support GenAI initiatives
* Apply LLMOps approaches and monitoring frameworks to improve production deployment outcomes
* Contribute to prompt management efforts and RAG evaluation work to increase application accuracy
* Engage in mentorship activities and share expertise throughout the wider architecture team
* Uphold rigorous production\-quality coding standards within Python\-based applications
* Champion continual improvements in system architecture and the scalability of solutions

**Requirements**

* 9 to 14 years of experience within software development, backed by a strong background in solution architecture and system design
* Advanced\-level Python programming ability with an emphasis on producing production\-quality code
* Proficiency spanning microservices architecture, design patterns, FastAPI, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Kafka
* Considerable experience developing GenAI applications, including work with Agents, MCP, RAG, Agentic RAG, and GraphRAG
* Thorough understanding of LangGraph, LangChain, and comparable orchestration technologies
* Direct experience conducting LLM and RAG evaluations, plus managing prompt\-related workflows
* Solid history of successfully delivering scalable, production\-ready GenAI applications
* Practical exposure to cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Working familiarity with containerization solutions such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Knowledge of vector database technologies, including options like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma
* Clear understanding of LLMOps concepts and the tools used for monitoring
* Proven leadership qualities capable of guiding and directing engineering teams
* Ability to perform effectively in client\-facing roles while collaborating across teams
* Proficient English communication abilities, spoken and written, at a B2 level or higher

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to classic machine learning approaches, such as feature engineering, model training, and performance evaluation
* Knowledge of knowledge graph structures and fine\-tuning methodologies
* Background in consulting work or roles requiring direct client interaction

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Architect
description:
**OPENING FOR SENIOR ARCHITECTS – 3\-10 YEARS**

**Company:** Cubatic Design  
**Website:** www.cubaticdesign.com

**About Us**

Cubatic Design is a multidisciplinary design studio specializing in **Architecture, Interior Design, Urban Design, and Landscape Design**. We are passionate about creating innovative, functional, and sustainable spaces that enhance the built environment. Our collaborative approach combines creativity, technical excellence, and attention to detail to deliver exceptional design solutions across diverse project scales.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a talented and experienced **Senior Architect** to lead architectural projects from concept development through execution. The ideal candidate will possess strong design capabilities, technical expertise, project management skills, and leadership qualities to successfully deliver high\-quality projects while mentoring and guiding design teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Design Leadership**

* Lead the architectural design process from conceptual planning to detailed design and construction documentation.
* Develop innovative, functional, and aesthetically strong design solutions aligned with project goals and client expectations.
* Prepare and present design concepts, master plans, 3D visualizations, presentations, and design reports.
* Ensure design excellence while maintaining compliance with building regulations, zoning requirements, and industry standards.

**Project Planning \& Execution**

* Manage multiple projects across architecture, interiors, urban design, and landscape design disciplines.
* Coordinate with consultants, engineers, contractors, and project stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution.
* Monitor project schedules, design deliverables, and quality standards throughout all project phases.
* Conduct site visits, design reviews, and project evaluations as required.

**Technical Documentation**

* Oversee the preparation of construction drawings, working drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Ensure accuracy and quality control of all design and construction documents.
* Utilize AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion, Photoshop, and related software for design development and presentation.

**Team Management \& Mentorship**

* Lead, mentor, and supervise architects, designers, and drafting professionals.
* Review design outputs, technical drawings, and project submissions prepared by team members.
* Encourage collaboration, innovation, and professional growth within the design team.
* Support the Principal Architect in managing project teams and design coordination activities.

**Client \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as a key point of contact for clients and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead client presentations, design discussions, and project meetings.
* Build strong professional relationships while ensuring client satisfaction and project success.

**Material \& Design Research**

* Research and recommend materials, finishes, products, and construction methodologies suitable for project requirements.
* Stay updated with emerging design trends, technologies, and sustainable design practices.
* Assist in preparing project specifications and material selections.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Architecture from a recognized and accredited institution.

**Experience**

* Minimum **2–10 years of professional experience** in architecture and design.
* Experience working with architecture, interior design, urban design, or multidisciplinary design firms is preferred.
* Proven track record of successfully handling projects from concept to completion.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of architectural design principles, construction methodologies, building systems, and detailing.
* Thorough knowledge of building codes, zoning regulations, statutory approvals, and site planning requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in:
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Lumion
* Adobe Photoshop
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with Revit/BIM workflows will be considered an added advantage.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong design vision and creative problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership and team management capabilities.
* Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* High level of attention to detail and commitment to design quality.
* Strong analytical thinking and decision\-making skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and adaptable to evolving project requirements.

**Why Join Cubatic Design?**

* Opportunity to work on diverse Architecture, Interior, Urban Design, and Landscape projects.
* Collaborative and creative work environment.
* Exposure to innovative design challenges and multidisciplinary projects.
* Professional growth and leadership opportunities.
* Platform to contribute to meaningful and impactful design solutions.

**Join Cubatic Design and help shape inspiring spaces that define the future of design.**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

title: 3d visualizer
description:
**Company Description**

**Praxis Group is an Interior Design \& Built Solutions provider based in Gurugram. We deliver residential, commercial, and office interior projects through design consultation, renovation, and turnkey execution, with a strong focus on quality and client satisfaction.**

**Job Description: 3D Designer – Interior Design**

**Job Title:** 3D Designer  
**Department:** Design  
**Industry:** Interior Design / Architecture / Furniture  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1–4 years  
**Location:** Gurgaon

Salary – 30K – 45K  
**Reporting To:** Design Head / Senior Interior Designer

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **3D Designer** to join our interior design team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of interior spaces, materials, furniture, lighting, and visual aesthetics, along with the ability to convert 2D concepts and design ideas into high\-quality 3D visualizations.

The candidate will be responsible for creating realistic 3D models, renders, walkthroughs, and presentation visuals for residential and/or commercial interior projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create detailed **3D models and realistic renders** for interior spaces based on design concepts, layouts, and drawings.
* Develop 3D views for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, retail spaces, hospitality projects, and other interiors.
* Translate **2D floor plans, elevations, and design concepts** into accurate 3D models.
* Select and apply appropriate materials, textures, colors, furniture, fixtures, and lighting.
* Produce high\-quality **photorealistic renders** for client presentations and design approvals.
* Prepare multiple design options and make revisions based on client and design\-team feedback.
* Coordinate with interior designers, architects, project managers, and execution teams to ensure design accuracy.
* Maintain accurate dimensions and ensure that 3D designs are practical and aligned with actual site conditions.
* Create mood boards, material presentations, and visual concepts when required.
* Stay updated with current interior design trends, materials, finishes, furniture styles, and visualization techniques.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned 3D design and rendering projects.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **3D modeling, rendering, lighting, materials, and texturing**.
* Proficiency in software such as:
* **3ds Max / SketchUp**
* **V\-Ray / Corona Renderer / Enscape / Lumion**
* **AutoCAD**
* **Photoshop**
* Good understanding of **interior design principles, space planning, materials, and furniture**.
* Ability to create realistic lighting and material finishes.
* Strong attention to detail and visual sense.
* Ability to understand technical drawings and architectural plans.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work on multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong creative and problem\-solving abilities.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma/Bachelor's degree in **Interior Design, Architecture, 3D Visualization, or a related field**.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in interior design visualization or 3D rendering.
* Candidates with a strong portfolio of interior projects will be preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* Residential interiors
* Modular kitchens and wardrobes
* Commercial interiors
* Retail and hospitality projects
* Furniture visualization
* Photorealistic architectural rendering
* 360° views and walkthroughs

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Quality and realism of 3D visualizations
* Accuracy of designs and dimensions
* Turnaround time for renders and revisions
* Ability to understand and implement design briefs
* Number of revisions required due to design/technical errors
* Coordination with the design and project teams
* Client satisfaction with presentation visuals

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

About this opportunity


The Solution Architect – FinTech is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering end\-to\-end technical and business solutions across digital payments, mobile money, lending, KYC, digital identity, merchant solutions, and financial services platforms. This role requires strong financial domain knowledge, deep technical expertise, and the ability to work consultatively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. The architect will lead solution scoping, requirement analysis, technical design, and deployment oversight while ensuring compliance, security, performance, and regulatory alignment across markets.

  

Key Responsibilities


FinTech Solution Design \& Architecture  

Design scalable, secure, and regulatory\-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations.  

Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions.  

Translate business requirements into detailed technical designs spanning cloud, APIs, microservices, protocols, and core financial systems.  

Ensure solutions adhere to financial industry standards (PCI\-DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, AML/CFT, data privacy, etc.).  

Customer Engagement \& Consultative Advisory  

Engage with banks, fintech operators, mobile money providers, and partners to understand business goals and technical landscapes.  

Lead workshops, requirement sessions, and technical deep\-dives to define use cases and solution scope.  

Prepare and deliver technical proposals, architecture documents, and customer presentations.  

Support commercial teams with solution positioning, negotiation, and value articulation.Project Delivery \& Implementation Support  

Support implementation teams during development, integration, testing, and rollout of FinTech platforms.  

Provide architectural governance and ensure alignment with solution blueprint throughout delivery.  

Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, performance evaluation, and transaction throughput modeling.  

Work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations teams to ensure successful deployment.  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration  

Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R\&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features.  

Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.

  

Technical Skills


Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.  

Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high\-volume financial transactions.


Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.  

Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks.  

Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows.  

Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization).  

Business \& Leadership Skills  

Strong consultative and customer\-facing capabilities.  

Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact.  

Ability to mentor, guide teams, and collaborate across multi\-functional units.  

Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.
